ForwardedHeaders.//: Trusted upstream proxy CIDR ranges. Leave empty/omit to default to Cloudflare's published ranges.
ForwardedHeaders.//local: Local hops between Cloudflare and the app (e.g. cloudflared tunnel container). Always trusted. Omit to default to loopback + Docker bridge range 172.16.0.0/12, which trusts every container on the host's Docker networks; set the tunnel network's subnet to narrow it. Invalid entries stop the app at startup.
